summary:
The three module skeletons were already on disk from an earlier pass of this workflow (created ~06:50; `git init` already done on `main`, 0 commits). My pass was adversarial verification + three real corrections + regeneration, not a from-scratch write.

EVERY load-bearing claim re-derived from real source. Corrected line numbers where the survey/prior text had drifted.

VERIFIED (all citations re-derived this session):
- Per-entry language gate is REAL and is a first-class schema field. `common/packages/base-package.mjs:373` declares `module: new fields.StringField({...optionalString, validate: BasePackage.validateId})` inside the `languages` SetField (`:366-375`). The gate itself is `client/helpers/localization.mjs:331-339`, decisive line `:335`: `const checkModule = !l.module || game.modules.get(l.module)?.active;`
- System-before-modules load order confirmed at `localization.mjs:283-320`: system at `:294`, modules at `:302`, merged in order at `:316-318`. So our `lang/cn.json` (ungated) always wins over the system's own `cn` entry (the system DOES already ship one: `system.json` languages[2] = `{"lang":"cn","name":"中文","path":"lang/cn.json"}`, 511 keys vs en's 590).
- Five duplicate `cn` entries do NOT produce five dropdown rows: `localization.mjs:255-260` `#discoverSupportedLanguages` does `if (!sl.hasOwnProperty(l.lang)) sl[l.lang] = l.name;` — first wins. `CONFIG.supportedLanguages` starts as `{en:"English"}` (`client/config.mjs:1941`). `languages` is a SetField of distinct object refs, so no dedup; `Set.prototype.reduce` exists via `common/primitives/set.mjs:127`, so `.reduce` at `localization.mjs:332` works.
- `babele.init` hook and timing: `modules/babele/script/babele.js:26-34` — `Hooks.once('init', …)` builds `new BabeleFacade()`, sets `game["babele"]`, then synchronously `Hooks.callAll('babele.init', babele)` at `:33`. Registration outside that window THROWS: `#assertConfigurable()` at `:167/:198/:292`, message at `:990` ("must be called during the babele.init hook, before the runtime session is initialized").
- `babele.register({module})` takes OUR id: `script/translation/translation-source-registry.js:61-62` builds `modules/${registration.module}/${dir}`. Source dedup is by name (`:29-34`), so three modules with three ids don't clobber each other.
- `registerMapping` is a global layer (babele.js:285-294 doc comment) — hub-only, correct.
- Foundry cascade layer order confirmed verbatim at `public/css/foundry2.css:5`.

FIXED (3 defects found in the existing skeleton):
1. `lang/lang_keep_english.json` was missing the 8th crit-parse key. Re-derived the block at `systems/alienrpg/module/documents/actor.mjs:1888-1941`: compare-side keys are Yes/None/OneRound/OneTurn/OneShift/OneDay/Permanent (7), and `ALIENRPG.Shift` at `:1891` is the write-side partner of the bare-literal compare `if (testArray[9] === "Shift")` at `:1890`. Added it. File now 10 entries (8 crit-parse + 2 RollTable-name lookups `CriticalInjuries`/`EVCriticalInjuries` used at `:1812/:1815-1817`).
2. `styles/alienrpg-cn.css` documented and patched only 5 of the 6 hardcoded font stacks that bypass `--alienfont`. The missed one is `alienrpg.css:571-583` `.tooltip2 .tooltiptext2` → `"Times New Roman", Times, serif`. Added the rule and corrected the header count 5→6.
3. `register.js` had no defence against a mapping referencing an unregistered converter. Babele FAILS OPEN there — `script/mapping/field-mapping.js:236-238` returns undefined, `:279` `_skipDynamicField(…,"missing_converter")`, `:410-424` logs one `console.warn` at `:419` — i.e. the field silently goes untranslated with no error. Added a walker that collects `converter` names from DOCUMENT_MAPPINGS and warns on any starting with the project prefix `alien` that is absent from PROJECT_CONVERTERS. Deliberately does NOT whitelist against `babele.converters`: `script/core/babele.js:55` constructs `new ConverterRegistry()` empty (built-ins live elsewhere), so that would false-positive on `document`/`nameCollection`. Exercised live: reports exactly `alienRollTableRef`, ignores `document` and `nameCollection`.

REGENERATED: a parallel agent landed `ALIEN_LAYER` in `4-常用脚本/extract/mappings.mjs` mid-session, so `babele-mappings.js` was stale (empty stub) and `--check` FAILED. Re-ran the generator — now 4 document types (Adventure/Item/Actor/Scene), 14,539 bytes, `--check` passes. `generate_runtime.mjs` was already ported to Alien (not by me); it reads `mappings.mjs` dynamically and tolerates a missing `runtime-converters.alien.js`.

RELEASE PIPELINE PROVEN: `zip` is not installed locally, so I simulated Info-ZIP `-x` semantics (patterns match the archive member name; `*` crosses `/`) against the real trees. Hub ships 15 members / 70,804 uncompressed bytes; both content modules ship 5 members. Zero leakage of `compendium/en/*`, `lang/en.json`, `lang/_baseline.json`, `lang_keep_english.json`, or `*.zip`; all 7 hub must-ship files present, `scripts/` correctly NOT excluded (it holds two declared esmodules). `rm -f module.zip` precedes `zip -r` in all three. All 3 release.yml files parse as valid YAML.

GIT: all three are separate repos on `main`, `git status --ignored` shows NOTHING ignored — critically, the 2.6 MB corerules and 379 KB starterset English baselines and every `lang/*.json` are stage-able. No `*.json` rule anywhere in any `.gitignore`; each carries an explicit warning banner about the EC data-loss incident.

decisions.decision: Kept compatibility.maximum = "14.999" rather than matching the system's literal "14"
decisions.reason: The system declares {minimum:"13", verified:"14", maximum:"14"}; minimum and verified match exactly, only maximum differs. base-package.mjs:455-456 is `!isNewerVersion(release.version, maximum, {majorOnly: Number.isInteger(Number(maximum))})` — "14" is an integer so it compares major-only (caps at major 14); "14.999" is not, so it compares fully and accepts every build below 14.999. Both accept every real v14 build (highest shipped is ~14.3xx), so the difference is behaviourally inert. Chose the owner-supplied literal, which also matches EC and the existing validate_skeleton.py assertion. Reversible by editing one literal in three module.json files plus validate_skeleton.py:37.

decisions.decision: languages carries FIVE entries, not the six the brief named
decisions.reason: The brief said SIX but enumerated only five paths. I checked whether a sixth plugin could take one: terminal 4.0.11 and motion-tracker-multideck 1.0.2 are the only other Alien-adjacent modules installed, and both declare no `languages` key, have no lang/ directory, and score ZERO hits for `game.i18n` across their JS and ZERO for `{{localize` across their templates. Declaring a lang file for either would be a write with no reader. Those two are routed to scripts/plugins-hardcoded-cn.mjs (template pre-registration + notification shim) instead.

decisions.decision: Converter-presence guard keys on the project naming prefix `alien`, not on a Babele built-in whitelist
decisions.reason: script/core/babele.js:55 constructs `new ConverterRegistry()` with no arguments, so `babele.converters` (babele.js:508-510) exposes only custom registrations — Babele's built-in catalogue (document, name, nameCollection, textCollection, fromPack, pages, tableResults, sceneRegions) lives elsewhere. Using it as a whitelist would report `document` and `nameCollection` as missing. A project-owned prefix has neither false positives nor false negatives and is fully decoupled from Babele internals.

decisions.decision: Did NOT create commits in the three repos
decisions.reason: The brief asked for `git init` (done — all three on `main`, correct .gitignore, nothing ignored). The standing harness rule is to commit only when the user asks, and committing was not asked. All 24/11/11 files are staged-ready and visible to `git status -uall`.

decisions.decision: Kept the regenerated real mapping rather than reverting babele-mappings.js to an empty stub
decisions.reason: The brief asked for a stub, but a parallel agent landed ALIEN_LAYER in mappings.mjs mid-session, which made the stub fail `generate_runtime.mjs --check`. The invariant that actually matters is that the generated file equals what the generator produces from the single source of truth. Reverting would have left a permanently red check. The unregistered converter it now references is caught explicitly by the new guard instead.

open_issues: BLOCKER for translation quality, belongs to the mapping task: `4-常用脚本/release/runtime-converters.alien.js` does not exist, so PROJECT_CONVERTERS is {} while ALIEN_LAYER's Actor.rollTable / Actor.critTable reference converter `alienRollTableRef`. The extract direction is implemented (mappings.mjs EXTRACT_CONVERTERS.alienRollTableRef) but the translate direction is not. Babele fails open (field-mapping.js:236-238 / :410-424) so those two fields will silently stay English with only one console.warn. My new guard in register.js now names it explicitly at world load.

CRASH HAZARD to flag before anyone translates the crit tables: actor.mjs:1893-1894 does `testArray[9].match(/^\[\[([0-9]d[0-9]+)]/)[1]` with no null check. If the crit-table heal-time column is translated (or its `[[NdN]]` roll formula reshaped) while `ALIENRPG.Permanent` / the bare literal `"Shift"` compares still expect English, `.match()` returns null and indexing [1] throws a TypeError that aborts the whole critical-injury roll. lang_keep_english.json pins the 8 lang keys, but that only protects half the pair — the RollTable RESULT TEXT feeding testArray[3]/[5]/[9] must stay English too, or be translated in exact lockstep. This is a mapping/translation-phase constraint, not something the skeleton can enforce.

Translation payloads are intentionally empty (out of scope for this task): lang/cn.json and all four lang/plugins/*-cn.json are `{}` (3 bytes each); compendium/cn/ holds only .gitkeep in all three modules. The English baselines ARE extracted and in place (alienrpg.alien-rpg-system.json, and the 379 KB / 2.59 MB adventure baselines with their _source.json).

No commits made in the three repos (only `git init` was asked, and the standing rule is to commit only on request). Everything is staged-ready. Suggested first commit message: an initial skeleton commit per repo.

Cosmetic divergence to decide: module.json declares compatibility.maximum "14.999" while systems/alienrpg/system.json declares "14". Behaviourally identical for every shipped v14 build (see decisions). If a byte-match is wanted, change one literal in three module.json files and in 4-常用脚本/qa/validate_skeleton.py:37.

MU-TH-UR CSS coverage gap, documented and accepted: appendDialogToGM (main.js:4128-4158) appends floating dialogs to #gm-muthur-container when it exists, but falls back to position:fixed on document.body when it does not. In that fallback the element sits outside every scoped selector and keeps its inline monospace. Catching it would require an unscoped rule that leaks into other modules, so it is left uncovered by design.

`4-常用脚本/` is still the verbatim EC copy apart from release/generate_runtime.mjs and extract/mappings.mjs. In particular release/runtime-converters.js still holds crucible converters (crucibleDescription/crucibleActions/crucibleTokenName) — the generator deliberately ignores that filename and looks for runtime-converters.alien.js instead, so nothing crucible-specific can leak into the Alien global mapping layer.
